prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 产品对比 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 79px
  col 2: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 50px
  col 3: header "屏幕" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 100px
  col 4: header "续航" · longest unbreakable word 20px · one-line width 59px
  col 5: header "重量" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 39px
  col 6: header "评价" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 445px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者比较四款手机的价格、规格与评价，找到适合自己的型号。","reading":"读者先按型号定位，再横向比较同一行的价格、屏幕、续航、重量和评价；也会纵向扫描同一指标。行高应由较长的评价自然决定，其他单元格可利用同一行的高度换行。","groups":["型号是每行的识别入口；价格是独立的购买指标。","屏幕、续航和重量都是可纵向比较的规格，宽度应支持数字与单位的辨认。","评价是描述性文字，与前面的短规格不同，需要更多换行空间。"],"keep_intact":["价格及其货币符号和数字","型号中的 X1、Pro、Air、Max 等标识","屏幕尺寸、分辨类型以及重量数值和单位应尽量保持易读"],"may_wrap":["型号名称可在系列名与后缀之间换行","屏幕尺寸与面板类型可分行","续航的约数和天数可在自然位置换行","评价可按中文语义自然换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [70, 71, 65, 45, 47, 61] · table 360×1275px · row heights [60, 385, 362, 176, 292] · column headers wrapped 2/6 · tallest cell 16 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [88, 71, 60, 41, 47, 52] · table 360×1275px · row heights [60, 385, 362, 176, 292] · column headers wrapped 2/6 · tallest cell 16 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [50, 71, 60, 41, 47, 90] · table 360×694px · row heights [60, 199, 176, 106, 153] · column headers wrapped 3/6 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"型号可按系列名和后缀分行，价格完整，屏幕类型也能辨认；各行仍有明确的网格边界。","problems":"评价被挤成很窄的文字带，导致行高过大，规格下方留下大片空白，横向比较也变得费力。续航和重量的表头各拆成两行，重量数字与 g 分离，屏幕中的“英寸”也被拆开。","cause":"评价列仅 61px，扣除内边距后只有 40px；续航列 45px、重量列 47px，均不足以容纳完整的双字表头，屏幕列 65px 也难以同时容纳尺寸和完整单位。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"型号列较宽，部分型号能保持一行或只在后缀前换行；价格完整，屏幕尺寸与单位的分行较容易理解。","problems":"评价比 r0A 更窄，文字逐字堆叠，仍支配整行高度；较宽的型号列因此伴随大量空白。续航、重量表头折行，重量数字和单位分离。","cause":"型号列增至 88px，但评价列降至 52px，实际文字宽度仅 31px；续航和重量分别只有 41px、47px。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"评价列加宽后，短语更容易连续阅读，行高明显降低，整体比另外两稿更紧凑；价格仍完整，屏幕类型可辨认。","problems":"型号作为定位入口过窄，系列名被逐字拆开，型号标识也被迫另起行；型号、续航和重量三个表头折行。重量数字与 g 分离，屏幕尺寸和单位的断行也不稳定。","cause":"评价列增至 90px，空间主要取自型号列；型号列仅 50px、续航 41px、重量 47px，扣除 21px 后都不足以容纳完整双字表头。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-review","widths":[59,71,60,51,51,67],"change":"以 r0C 为基础，让型号、续航和重量表头各有 30px 文字空间，保留完整价格；评价列仍比 r0A 宽，争取在评价可读性与定位、规格表头之间取得平衡。"},{"name":"review-first","widths":[51,71,60,51,51,75],"change":"优先改善评价的短语连续性，同时让六个双字表头均有 30px 文字空间；型号预计按系列名与后缀分行，适合以阅读评价为主的比较。"},{"name":"specs-first","widths":[51,71,65,51,60,61],"change":"给屏幕和重量更多空间，尝试保住尺寸单位及重量数字与 g 的组合；评价仍需较多换行，但规格的纵向扫描会更清楚。"}]}
